steps.title: Welcome
steps.goal: Set expectations and choose how deep to go.
steps.screen: About 10 minutes. Every step is skippable.

steps.title: Personal setup
steps.goal: Finish the setup the installer deferred.
steps.screen: This password also unlocks the encrypted disk at every boot.

steps.title: Connect to the internet
steps.goal: Get online, because updates, agents and web apps need it.
steps.screen: Press Super + Ctrl + W to open the network panel.

steps.title: Meet the Super key
steps.done_when: The app sees the key press while focused.

steps.title: Open the Omarchy menu
steps.screen: Almost everything lives in here. When you're lost, start here.

steps.title: Launch and tile two apps
steps.done_when: A terminal and a browser are open on the same workspace and focus has moved once.

subtasks.label: Super + Shift + Return opens the browser

steps.title: Close, float and full screen
steps.tip: Super + T floats a window, Super + F goes full screen, Super + W closes.

subtasks.label: Super + T floats the terminal, and again to tile it
Super + F goes full screen, and again to return

steps.title: Workspaces
steps.done_when: A workspace switch and a move-to-workspace are seen.

subtasks.label: Super + Shift + 2 sends the terminal over

steps.title: Copy and paste the Omarchy way
steps.tip: Super + C, V and X copy, paste and cut everywhere, including the terminal.
steps.done_when: The field contains the expected text.

steps.title: Find any shortcut
steps.screen: You don't need to memorize anything. Super + K is always there.

steps.title: Pick a theme
steps.screen: Arrow keys preview, Enter applies. Super + Ctrl + Space cycles backgrounds later.
steps.done_when: A theme is applied (keeping the current one counts).

steps.title: Display and comfort
steps.screen: Super + / scales up, Super + Alt + / scales down. Super + Ctrl + N toggles nightlight.
steps.done_when: The user confirms it looks right.

steps.title: Quick hardware check
steps.done_when: Each shown item is done or skipped.

steps.title: Your everyday apps
steps.screen: Each app has its own hotkey. Try one.

steps.title: Choose your AI agent
steps.screen: Setting an agent installs it if needed and opens it so you can sign in.
steps.done_when: A default agent is set, or skipped.

steps.title: Updates and snapshots
steps.screen: Always update with omarchy update, not pacman -Syu, so you get a snapshot first.
steps.done_when: The update finishes or the user chooses Later.

steps.title: You're ready
steps.screen: Re-run any lesson later with omarchy onboarding --step <name>.
